description: Fix webhook retry/DLQ system: concurrency flooding, missing retry cap in cron, DLQ cleanup, and exponential backoff arithmetic errors
steps: 1. In lib/webhooks.ts retryFailedWebhooks(): Add a concurrency limiter - currently processes all 50 failed webhooks in parallel with no rate control. Add a semaphore/batch pattern (process max 5 concurrently) to prevent thundering herd on the target servers when many webhooks fail at once.

2. In lib/webhooks.ts retryFailedWebhooks(): The retry loop fetches items where attempt < MAX_RETRIES (5) but the getRetryDelay() array only has 4 entries. When attempt=4, getRetryDelay(5) returns -1 (dead letter), meaning the 5th attempt never actually fires - it immediately dead-letters. Fix the off-by-one: either reduce MAX_RETRIES to 4 or add a 5th delay entry.

3. In lib/webhooks.ts fireWebhooks(): When the initial delivery fails (non-2xx), it sets status='failed' and nextRetryAt but does NOT increment the attempt counter from 0 to 1. This means retryFailedWebhooks picks it up and computes getRetryDelay(1)=5min, but the first retry was supposed to be the '0 to 1' transition. Fix by setting attempt=1 on initial failure.

4. In lib/webhooks/delivery.ts processWebhookDelivery(): The exponential backoff calculation uses Math.pow(2, attempt) * 60 seconds which grows too aggressively (attempt 3 = 480 seconds = 8 min for the 3rd retry). Add a cap of maxDelay (e.g., 3600 seconds = 1 hour) to prevent unreasonably long retry delays.

5. In lib/webhooks/dlq.ts purgeOldDLQEntries(): This function exists but is never called by any cron job. Create a scheduled cleanup in app/api/cron/retry-webhooks/route.ts that purges DLQ entries older than 30 days after the retry pass.

6. In lib/webhooks.ts retryFailedWebhooks(): The function queries items where nextRetryAt <= now(), but if the cron doesn't run for hours (e.g., server restart), ALL queued retries become eligible at once, causing a retry storm. Add a limit to process at most 50 per run (already exists) but also add a check: if there are more than 50 eligible, log a warning about backlog accumulation.
7. Add unit tests in tests/unit/webhook-retry-fixes.test.ts testing: concurrency limiting behavior, off-by-one fix in retry count, DLQ purge integration, and backoff cap.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook retries process with concurrency control (max 5 parallel)
getRetryDelay is consistent with MAX_RETRIES (no off-by-one causing immediate dead-letter)
Initial webhook failure correctly sets attempt=1
Exponential backoff is capped at a reasonable maximum
DLQ entries older than 30 days are purged during cron runs
Backlog warning logged when retry queue exceeds batch size
All new unit tests pass with npx vitest run
